name: Italian Seasoning
siboNotes: Most dried herb blends are well-tolerated in typical cooking amounts. Check labels to ensure no garlic or onion powder is added.
preparationTips: Read ingredient labels carefully - some commercial blends contain garlic or onion powder
Make your own blend with basil, oregano, thyme, and rosemary for guaranteed FODMAP-free seasoning
Store in airtight container away from light to maintain potency
Use generously as herbs provide flavor without FODMAPs
alternatives: Individual herbs like dried basil or oregano
pairsWellWith: Roasted vegetables like zucchini and bell peppers
nutritionalHighlights: Provides flavor without sodium or calories
Source of vitamin K from dried herbs
